[color=#ff6666]Objective:[/color] Escape the complex without being detected.

A detection meter will appear whenever you get too close to a light source. If the meter fills completely, you are caught.

Watch out for the patrolling drone and its powerful red light. If it spots you, it will begin pursuing you. If it gets too close, your detection meter will rise rapidly.

[color=#ff6666]Controls:[/color]
- [color=#ff6666]\[WASD][/color] or the [color=#ff6666]\[Arrow Keys][/color] to move.
- [color=#ff6666]\[Mouse][/color] to look around.

[color=#ff6666]Click[/color] anywhere to start.
